facts.text: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia is located right on the beach of Santo Tomas in Menorca.
facts.excerpt: Located right on the beach of Santo Tomás, Villa Le Blanc Gran Meliá stands as the first grand luxury hotel in Menorca.

facts.text: The hotel has direct access to Santo Tomas beach from its garden.
facts.excerpt: On the seafront, with direct access to Santo Tomás beach from the garden

facts.text: The hotel sits within the Cami de Cavalls route.
facts.excerpt: Within the Camí de Cavalls route, in intimate connection with the island's nature

facts.text: The hotel's interior design is inspired by Menorca's vernacular architecture, with light flooding the spaces through large arches.
facts.excerpt: it is inspired by the island's vernacular architecture for its exquisite interior design, where light floods the spaces through large arches

facts.text: The hotel was conceived as a prototype hotel in terms of efficiency and environmental responsibility.
facts.excerpt: Conceived as a prototype hotel in terms of efficiency and environmental responsibility

facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: This hotel is a member of "The Leading Hotels of the World".

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as the first grand luxury hotel in Menorca.
facts.excerpt: The first grand luxury hotel in Menorca, a white stone refuge facing the Mediterranean

facts.text: The rooftop pool is for adults only and has Bali beds and sun beds around it.
facts.excerpt: Carefully designed, our Adults Only rooftop offers a magnificent pool and Bali beds.

facts.text: The main pool faces the Mediterranean and its design is inspired by a beach club from the Balearic coast's golden years.
facts.excerpt: an open-air space facing the Mediterranean Sea with a design inspired by a beach club from the Balearic coast's golden years

facts.text: At the Thai Room Spa, native Thai therapists offer massages and treatments from Thailand.
facts.excerpt: Native Thai therapists bring the best massages and treatments from their homeland to our hotel creating a wellness haven for mind and body.

facts.text: The Grand Blanc massage was created by Thai Room exclusively for Villa Le Blanc and includes a scrub with white sesame and Menorcan fleur de sel.
facts.excerpt: You will enjoy a full body scrub with white sesame and fleur de sel flakes from Menorca.

facts.text: All Thai Room treatments include full access to the spa, whose circuit has a dynamic pool, outdoor hot tub, steam room and sauna.
facts.excerpt: All Thai Room treatments grant you complimentary and full access to our spa. For optimal benefits, try our spa circuit: dynamic swimming pool, outdoor hot tub, steam room, sauna and showers.

facts.text: La Terraza del Balear focuses on fresh fish, handmade rice dishes and local specialities.
facts.excerpt: Refined dishes with a focus on fresh fish, handmade rice dishes and local specialities

facts.text: La Terraza del Balear serves caldereta, the traditional Menorcan lobster stew.
facts.excerpt: "La Caldereta", the star dish in Menorca, is a tempting lobster stew that captures the essence of Menorcan cuisine.

facts.text: La Terraza del Balear has a formal dress code.
facts.excerpt:
Dress code
Formal
Atmosphere
Elegant

facts.text: Nivi is a Mediterranean grill restaurant where grilled dishes meet locally sourced Menorcan ingredients with a hint of Italian flavours.
facts.excerpt: where grilled delicacies meet locally sourced Menorcan ingredients enhanced by an international flair and a hint of Italian flavours

facts.text: Nivi also serves a buffet breakfast with a la carte and show cooking options.
facts.excerpt: A scenic venue where guests can also indulge in a buffet breakfast featuring a la carte and show cooking options.

facts.text: Le Blanc Grand Cafe is the all-day dining venue in the hotel's lobby.
facts.excerpt: Le Blanc Grand Cafe is the all-day dining concept in the lobby of Villa Le Blanc Gran Meliá

facts.text: At the kids club, children under 5 must be accompanied by an adult.
facts.excerpt: Children under the age of 5 years must be accompanied by an adult.

facts.text: The kids club is decorated in natural colours and based on alternative educational methods.
facts.excerpt: an exceptional games area, decorated in natural colours and based on alternative educational methods

facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly, allowing up to two pets per room.
facts.excerpt: A unique opportunity to enjoy time with your pet (up to 2 per room) in our pet-friendly hotels in Menorca.

facts.text: Guests can book the hotel's llauts, Marco Polo I and Marco Polo II, for a half or full day of sailing.
facts.excerpt: Book our exclusive llaüts (Marco Polo I and Marco Polo II) with different features to suit your needs. Sail the sea setting your own itinerary with a duration of half or full day

facts.text: The llaut trips stop at coves such as Cala Mitjana, Cala Macarella, Cala Macarelleta and Cales Coves.
facts.excerpt: in beautiful coves such as Cales Coves, Cala Mitjana, Cala Macarelleta and Cala Macarella

facts.text: The Artist's Inspiration experience sails by llaut from Mahon port to Isla del Rey for a guided visit to the Hauser and Wirth gallery.
facts.excerpt: Set sail from the refined port of Mahón on a traditional llaüt and navigate through crystal-clear waters to the Isla del Rey. Through a guided tour, explore the Hauser & Wirth gallery

facts.text: Guests can go horse riding along the Cami de Cavalls.
facts.excerpt: delight your senses with the sublime beauty of the Camí de Cavalls

facts.text: Through a Gran Melia partnership with Audi, guests can spend a day driving a fully electric Audi e-tron.
facts.excerpt: you can spend a day driving a brand-new Audi e-tron, a fully electric car combining innovation, design and sustainability

facts.text: The Sunset Master Suite has a private seafront pool.
facts.excerpt: Take your stay at Villa Le Blanc to another level with this suite that boasts a private seafront pool.

facts.text: The Supreme with Terrace Tub room has a terrace with a bathtub and side views of the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: The room is equipped with a terrace that boasts a great bathtub with side views of the Mediterranean Sea.

facts.text: The hotel is 28 km from the airport and 27 km from Mahon.
facts.excerpt:

facts.text: The hotel offers a personalized butler service.
facts.excerpt: - Personalized Butler Service

facts.text: The gym is open 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Our modern and fully equipped gym is open 24 hours.
